name: Critical Effects (DH2): Impact - Leg
description: Dark Heresy 2nd Edition, Table 7-18 (p. 239). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: Movement halved (rounding up) for 1 round. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or Stunned for 1 round and knocked Prone.
Leg broken. Stunned for 1 round and knocked Prone. Movement reduced to 1 metre until medical attention.
2 levels of Fatigue. Movement halved (rounding up) until medical attention. Challenging (+0) Toughness test or gain the Lost Foot condition.
Stunned for 2 rounds and knocked Prone. The leg is Useless until medical attention.
Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness test or die from shock. On a success: Blood Loss and the Lost Leg condition. Agility permanently reduced by [[1d5]].
As result 9. His screams drown out all conversation within [[2d10]] metres for the rest of the round.
